title: 16-06-pace-code-c-2015.pdf — section 117
text:
12. If the person making the statement cannot read, or refuses to read
it, or to write the above mentioned certificate at the end of it or
to sign it, the person taking the statement shall read it to them
and ask them if they would like to correct, alter or add anything
and to put their signature or make their mark at the end. The
person taking the statement shall certify on the statement itself
what has occurred.
 79
ANNEX E – Summary of Provisions Relating to Mentally
Disordered and Otherwise Mentally Vulnerable People or a
person with significant communication difficulties
Provisions relating to mentally disordered and otherwise
mentally vulnerable people

1. If an officer has any suspicion, or is told in good faith, that a
person of any age may be mentally disordered or otherwise
mentally vulnerable, or mentally incapable of understanding the
significance of questions or their replies that person shall be
treated as mentally disordered or otherwise mentally
vulnerable for the purposes of this Code. See paragraph 1.4 and
Note E4.
